pages.title: Error Correction
pages.text: $(thing)Error Correction$()$(br2)Add a few check bits, cleverly placed, and a flipped bit can be found and flipped back. Unlocks the Error-Correcting Code.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Information Theory, Modular Arithmetic.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Prime Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A Hamming code uses r check bits on a block of 2^r − 1 bits. Write the share C of the bits that carry data.
